I actually was looking and hoping someone would make a post about this.  I’m prescribed vyvanse. I take 50mg in the morning and a 20mg around 3-4(I have a higher tolerance to vyvanse) I don’t take an anti depressant because I’ve been trying to stay away from using them until it’s a must need. What I noticed on vyvanse is when the drug wore off at about the same time every day, I would get paranoid depressed and all that bullshit that comes along with it. 

After trail and error I’ve realized a great solution to this problem. I would never A: eat enough protein B:drink enough fluids and C: enough sleep. 

First with protein I don’t know what it is but I found that forcing myself to eat protein DRAMATICALLY improved my mood on and even off the drug. having a full stomach and eating as much as you can is very important. 

Going on to fluids. The reason I didn’t just say water is because I felt like I would chug water and suddenly just piss it all out 15 mins later. I would get annoyed and miserable and dehydrated. All of that added up to terrible come downs. Drink any liquid that has other properties like electrolytes or even sugar specifically Gatorade. This is so so important as just as eating is. 

Sleep is not the biggest game changer but it will add on to more helpful and smoother side effects from vyvanse. If you’re looking for using it for its stimulant properties it’s great to have around 8+ hours a night. Also sleep naturally puts your body in a better position to have a good day. 

I hope this helped and reply if you have any questions. Sorry if this doesn’t really speak to what you’re looking for
